The convention-breaking Rio proves that small can do big things, packing state-
of-the-art technology and outstanding mileage26 into its stylish, subcompact size.
There are two models to choose from: A versatile 5-door hatchback, or a sleek,
modern 4-door sedan. Both offer a roomy interior, available advanced driver-
assistance technologies,3* features like wireless Apple CarPlay®9 integration for
your iPhone and Android AutoTM10 for compatible AndroidTM10 smartphones, plus
great handling to help you smoothly maneuver through traffic. All while being
the perfect size to score the best parking spots in town.
